name: Three-Beat Pause
description: Breathe in for three, rest for two, breathe out for four, with only a brief pause between.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A gentle in, short rest, longer out pattern with a rest of only 2 seconds, on Breathing Space.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Five rounds take about a minute and a half.
howToPlay: Press Begin when you are ready.
Breathe in while the shape grows.
Let the breath rest softly, then breathe out as the shape shrinks.
tips: The rest is short and soft, not a held breath. If it feels odd, breathe out sooner or press Stop.
